independence.basis: Direct inspection of the complete canonical original PNG, not author descriptions or generated objects.

inventory.observation: One continuous water surface occupies most of the frame, between a near bank and a distant low shoreline.
inventory.requirement: An observable planar water surface, not an isolated sphere or a diagram of waves throughout a three-dimensional bulk.

inventory.observation: A small irregular disturbance/short dark marks lie near the center-right of the water, inside the nested ripple traces.
inventory.requirement: A localized common origin for the outward surface ripples.
inventory.uncertainty: The pixels do not establish a thrown object, thrower, exact impact cause, or a measured center coordinate.

inventory.observation: Several dark, broken, nested flattened oval arcs surround the central disturbance. The loops spread outward across the same surface, with larger traces toward the frame and bank.
inventory.requirement: Recognizable concentric circular surface ripples seen obliquely; no domes, spheres, or volumetric shells.
inventory.uncertainty: Broken and overlapping print traces do not justify an exact mandatory ring count, equal spacing, wavelength, or numerical radius.

inventory.observation: The left foreground bank contains a prominent leafy plant/tree mass with upright stems or trunks and finer vegetation at the edge.
inventory.requirement: Retain visible near-bank vegetation as landscape context; no species or cultural identity is specified.

inventory.observation: Irregular rocks and uneven bank forms appear at lower left and along the bottom edge, with a few separate protrusions along the lower-right bank.
inventory.requirement: Retain a rocky/uneven near shoreline that bounds the water without obscuring the ripple pattern.

inventory.observation: A low, irregular dark tree/vegetation line runs almost across the top of the water; the open water separates it from the near bank.
inventory.requirement: Retain a distant vegetated shore/tree line and the near/far depth relationship.

inventory.observation: A narrow light sky region is visible above the distant tree line.
inventory.requirement: Retain visible sky above the far shore; no weather, location, or historical identity is specified.

inventory.observation: No readable labels, values, units, axes, arrows, grid, subfigure letters, people, flags, or cultural symbols are visible.
inventory.requirement: Do not invent instructional values or labels, an answer-bearing annotation, a person, or cultural texture.

modernizationBoundary: Clean contemporary natural-scene artwork may replace ink hatching and print noise. Colors, species details, and smooth ripple rendering are stylistic additions, not facts extracted from the source.
